narrative:
## Board Submission Summary — GP & EBITDA Consolidation

## Key Decisions
• FY2026 GP NOK 1,690M, adj. EBITDA NOK 680M
• Conversational GP share 16.6%, path to 22% in FY2027
• Finance gate passed (GP within 5% of ambition, EBITDA > 38% of GP)

## Recommendations
• Accept the remaining routing and pricing levers to reach double-digit GP growth
• Track GP per message monthly by market in the Board & IR pack

## Risk Factors
• Operator price rises beyond plan
• Platform migration timing
